title: Nonemptiness of the Fin-block cast
statement: Fix $w \in \bbn$, and let $l$ be a list of pairs $(i, b) \in \bbn \times \{\mathrm{true}, \mathrm{false}\}$ each of whose first coordinates satisfies $i < w$. If $l$ is nonempty, then its cast into a list of pairs in $\mathrm{Fin}\,w \times \{\mathrm{true}, \mathrm{false}\}$ is again nonempty.
hypotheses_covered: l is a list of (natural, boolean) pairs
every entry of l has first coordinate less than w
